hints.tr: Birden fazla sütun parantezin içine virgülle yazılıyor: `CREATE INDEX ad ON events (a, b);`. Dizin önce `a`'ya, `a` eşitse `b`'ye göre sıralı.
hints.en: More than one column goes inside the parentheses, separated by commas: `CREATE INDEX name ON events (a, b);`. The index is sorted by `a` first, then by `b` where `a` is equal.

hints.tr: Eşitlikle aranan sütun (`customer_id = 3`) önde, aralıkla aranan (`created_at >= ... AND < ...`) arkada. Böylece 3 numaralı müşterinin satırları bir arada ve tarih sırasında duruyor.
hints.en: The column searched with equality (`customer_id = 3`) goes first, the one searched with a range (`created_at >= ... AND < ...`) second. That way customer 3's rows sit together, in date order.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
CREATE INDEX ix_events_customer_created ON events (customer_id, created_at);
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
CREATE INDEX ix_events_customer_created ON events (customer_id, created_at);
```

checks.query: SELECT STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN ic.is_included_column = 0 THEN c.name END, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal, c.name) AS key_columns, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN ic.is_included_column = 1 THEN c.name END, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal, c.name) AS included_columns, i.is_unique, i.filter_definition FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id = OBJECT_ID('events') AND i.is_primary_key = 0 GROUP BY i.index_id, i.is_unique, i.filter_definition ORDER BY key_columns;
